description: Delivery methods and prices for a destination country and an order. Pass the product ids (with quantities) to get the shipping weight and order total computed from current prices, or pass order_total and weight_kg directly.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. LV, LT, EE, PL, DE, FR. Defaults to the shop language's country.

lang.description: Shop language: lv, lt, ee, pl, de, en, fr, ru. Defaults to the language of the domain the request was sent to.

order_total.description: Order total in shop currency, used if items are not given.

weight_kg.description: Total weight in kg, used if items are not given.

name: get_delivery_options
